records.public_claim_text: Taking into account of the changing population structure over time and its difference across regions, the age-standardized death rate (ASR) for ages under 70 years was in steady decline from 2000 until the start of the COVID-19 pandemic in 2019, both globally and at regional level.

records.public_claim_text: In 2019, the African Region had the highest ASR of all deaths under age of years (665 per 100 000 population) among all WHO regions, over 80% higher than the global average (366 per 100 000 population) and nearly triple that of the Western Pacific Region (233 per 100 000), the region with the lowest ASRs.
